reading: Read a wide range of fiction, poetry, drama and non-fiction
Understand and respond to texts from different periods and cultures
Analyse authors' language choices, structure and form
Evaluate texts critically and support responses with textual evidence
writing: Write for a range of purposes and audiences with appropriate register
Plan, draft and revise extended writing
Use grammar, punctuation and spelling accurately (sentence types, cohesion, complex sentences)
Write narrative, descriptive, persuasive, analytical and informational texts
spokenLanguage: Participate in formal and informal discussion and debate
Deliver presentations with appropriate vocabulary, tone and intonation
Listen and respond to the ideas of others
grammarVocabulary: Use vocabulary precisely and in context
Understand sentence structures, clauses and phrases
Punctuation: comma, colon, semicolon, apostrophe, inverted commas

canonicalTexts: Shakespeare (at least one play), 19th-century fiction, modern fiction, pre-20th century poetry, contemporary poetry
